subject.title: [Bug]: Managed Memory Dreaming Promotion cron silently NO_REPLY since 2026-05-09 (jobs.json lastRun stays null)

question: Should managed Memory Dreaming cron treat any failed workspace as a cron-visible failure, or keep cron success and surface workspace failures through a separate doctor/Dreams Digest diagnostic?
rationale: The legacy storage causes are fixed, but changing the remaining status semantics affects retry behavior, alerting volume, and what operators see as a failed scheduled run.

options.title: Surface partial failures
options.body: Make failed Dreaming workspaces visible in cron run history and doctor while preserving the SQLite state path and bounded logging.

options.title: Keep cron success semantics
options.body: Treat per-workspace Dreaming failures as plugin-level diagnostics only and close this issue as covered by the SQLite migrations.

options.title: Split narrower follow-ups
options.body: Close only the legacy jobs.json/storage part and move diary-generation or pressure concerns to the existing narrower issues.

recommendation.title: Surface partial failures
recommendation.body: Make failed Dreaming workspaces visible in cron run history and doctor while preserving the SQLite state path and bounded logging.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the SQLite Dreaming-state migration and are the strongest recent owner for deciding how the remaining managed Dreaming failure contract should surface.
